summary: A Yes vote amends the City of Half Moon Bay Local Coastal Land Use Plan and the Subdivisions and Zoning titles of the Municipal Code so that the Measure D "Downtown Area" is redefined as the area designated as the "Town Center" in the Local Coastal Land Use Plan.

housing.text: Measure I would redefine the area where housing growth is concentrated while leaving existing development locations, densities and intensities unchanged.
housing.quote: Measure I will not change the location, density or intensity of development permitted under the 2020 LCLUP or the General Plan including the 2023 - 2031 Housing Element.

housing.text: The argument against Measure I said adding large developable parcels to the downtown allocation pool could worsen the concentration of housing allocations among large developers.
housing.quote: Large housing developers have been granted a huge proportion of available allocations, angering many residents. The map change may worsen this by adding large developable parcels to the downtown pool.
